models.notes: Announced 2023-03-14 with a closed-beta/business API. No public price at launch; $11.02/$32.68 per 1M tokens is Anthropic's July 2023 rate sheet, which says Claude 1 is still offered at the same price as Claude 2 (checked against the PDF). Scores are Claude 1.3 from the Claude 2 model card (MMLU 5-shot CoT 77.0, Codex HumanEval pass@1 56.0, GSM8K 0-shot CoT 85.2; checked against the PDF). Arena: claude-1 was hidden from the Arena after deprecation (retired from the API 2024-11-06) and is absent from every 2025 snapshot, so 1146 is the LMSYS value of 2024-03-26 (Tom's Guide table; the same table has Claude 3 Haiku 1179 and GPT-4-0314 1185 versus 1179 and 1186 on 2025-01-21, i.e. same scale within about 5). Flagged estimate. Parameter count and compute never disclosed.

Cheap/fast Claude tier launched alongside Claude 1 (2023-03-14). Price is the July 2023 rate sheet ($1.63/$5.51, checked against the PDF); Instant 1.2 (2023-08-09) and a later price cut brought it to about $0.80/$2.40. Scores are Claude Instant 1.1 from the Claude 2 model card (MMLU 5-shot CoT 73.4, Codex HumanEval pass@1 52.8, GSM8K 0-shot CoT 80.9; all three checked against the PDF). Arena: claude-instant-1 is not in the 2025-01-21 snapshot (retired 2024-11-06). Its last published Elo was 1110 in the LMSYS table of 2023-12-15, on the older scale where GPT-4-0314 read 1191 versus 1186 in Jan 2025 (and Claude-1 fell 1151 -> 1146 Dec 2023 -> Mar 2024), so shifted by -5 to 1105. Flagged estimate, about +/-5.

Public claude.ai beta plus API, 100K context. Official (Claude 2 model card, checked against the PDF): Codex HumanEval 71.2 (vs 56.0 for Claude 1.3), GSM8K 88.0, MMLU 5-shot CoT 78.5. Compute 3.866e24 FLOP is Epoch's speculative estimate (confirmed in the CSV). Price from Anthropic's July 2023 sheet. Arena: claude-2.0 is not in the 2025-01-21 snapshot (retired). Last published Elo was 1130 in the LMSYS table of 2023-12-15 (older scale, about 5 higher than Jan 2025 for anchor models), so set to 1125. Flagged estimate, about +/-5.

First 200K-token context; Anthropic claimed 2x fewer false statements and 30% fewer wrong answers on long documents, but published no standard benchmark scores (the Claude 2 model card appendix covers only recall/honesty), so scores are null (it behaves roughly like Claude 2.0). $8/$24 per 1M is the Nov 2023 pricing update. Arena: claude-2.1 is not in the 2025-01-21 snapshot (retired). Last published Elo was 1120 in the LMSYS table of 2023-12-15 (older scale), so set to 1115. Flagged estimate, about +/-5.

Official: MMLU 5-shot 86.8, GPQA Diamond 0-shot CoT 50.4, GSM8K 0-shot CoT 95.0, HumanEval 0-shot 84.9 (all re-checked in the Claude 3.5 Sonnet model-card addenda tables). SWE-bench Verified 22.2 is from Anthropic's Oct 2024 addendum (Table 2, Anthropic scaffold; checked). Compute 1.64e25 FLOP is Epoch's benchmark-imputed estimate (it is in the CSV's compute notes, the numeric column is blank, confidence Speculative). Arena: claude-3-opus-20240229, 1247 on the 2025-01-21 snapshot (peaked about 1253 in March 2024).

Mid-tier Claude 3; powered free claude.ai at launch. Launch-card scores: MMLU 5-shot 79.0 (LMSYS's model table also lists 0.790), GPQA Diamond 40.4, GSM8K 0-shot CoT 92.3, HumanEval 73.0 (GPQA, GSM8K and HumanEval re-checked in the 2024 addenda). Note Anthropic's later 3.5 Sonnet addenda quote MMLU 5-shot as 78.3 for the same model; the launch value 79.0 is used for consistency with the other launch-card numbers. Arena: claude-3-sonnet-20240229, 1201 on the 2025-01-21 snapshot. Compute and params undisclosed (Epoch has no estimate).

Announced 2024-03-04 as 'coming soon'; API availability 2024-03-13. MMLU 5-shot 75.2, HumanEval 0-shot 75.9, GPQA Diamond 33.3 and SWE-bench Verified 7.2 re-checked in Anthropic's Oct 2024 addendum (Tables 2 and 8); GSM8K 88.9 is the launch-card figure (not re-checked). Arena: claude-3-haiku-20240307, 1179 on 2025-01-21.

Anthropic's blog is dated 2024-06-21 but the model reached the API, Bedrock and Vertex on 2024-06-20 (API release notes). MMLU 5-shot 88.7 (0-shot CoT 88.3), GPQA Diamond 0-shot CoT 59.4, GSM8K 96.4, HumanEval 92.0 all checked in the June 2024 addendum; SWE-bench Verified 33.4 from the Oct 2024 addendum. Compute 2.7e25 FLOP is Epoch's estimate (confirmed in the CSV, Speculative). Arena: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620, 1268 on 2025-01-21.

Upgraded 3.5 Sonnet, same price; introduced computer use (beta). Oct 2024 addendum (checked): MMLU 5-shot 88.7 (5-shot CoT 90.5, 0-shot CoT 89.3), GPQA Diamond 65.0, HumanEval 93.7, SWE-bench Verified 49.0 (SOTA at the time). GSM8K was dropped from the new card, so null. Arena: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, 1283 on 2025-01-21 (Anthropic's top Arena model then). No separate compute estimate.

Announced 2024-10-22; API release 2024-11-04 (API release notes). Launch price $1/$5 per 1M, cut to $0.80/$4 on 2024-12-03 (Anthropic's own update note). MMLU 5-shot 77.6 (0-shot CoT 80.3), GPQA Diamond 41.6, HumanEval 88.1, MATH 69.2, SWE-bench Verified 40.6 (beat the original 3.5 Sonnet) all checked in the Oct 2024 addendum. GSM8K not reported. Arena: claude-3-5-haiku-20241022, 1238 on 2025-01-21.

Paper on arXiv 2018-10-11; code and checkpoints open-sourced 2018-11-02 (used as release date). SQuAD v1.1 F1 91.8 is the test F1 of single BERT-Large fine-tuned with TriviaQA augmentation (Table 2: plain single BERT-Large is 90.9 dev F1; the ensemble + TriviaQA reached 93.2 test F1). GLUE 80.5 is the official leaderboard score quoted in the paper. Compute 2.85e20 FLOP per Epoch (confirmed). Encoder-only, cannot generate text or chat, so Arena Elo 500 is a pure placeholder below the Arena floor (llama-13b about 799).

Text-to-text encoder-decoder, 60M to 11B variants, Apache-2.0 weights with the paper (2019-10-23). T5-11B, all checked in the paper's full-results table: SQuAD v1.1 dev EM 91.26 / F1 96.22 (note: dev set, whereas BERT's 91.8 is test), GLUE average 90.3, SuperGLUE 88.9. Compute 3.3e22 FLOP per Epoch (confirmed). Not instruction/chat tuned, so Arena Elo 650 is an extrapolated placeholder.

Announced 2020-01-28 and never released (announcement date used). 2.6B-parameter open-domain chatbot trained on about 341GB of social-media conversations, 30 days on a TPUv3 pod. Reported its own Sensibleness and Specificity Average of 79% with tuned decoding (72% without) vs 86% for humans. No standard LLM benchmarks. Compute 1.12e23 FLOP per Epoch. Arena Elo is an extrapolated placeholder.

Announced at Google I/O 2021-05-18 (paper Jan 2022); never sold as an API or released as weights, only limited public testing via AI Test Kitchen from Aug 2022 and then as the original Bard engine. 137B decoder-only dialog model pretrained on 1.56T words. Compute 3.55e23 FLOP per Epoch. No standard benchmark scores reported. Arena Elo is an estimate. Epoch dates the paper 2022-02-10; the I/O announcement date is kept here.

DeepMind (counted under gogle). Announced 2021-12-08 (paper + blog) and never released or sold. 280B dense decoder trained on about 300B tokens of MassiveText. MMLU 5-shot 60.0 as in the Gopher paper and quoted in the PaLM 2 report (Table 16). No other standard scores in the shared schema. Compute 6.31e23 FLOP and 280B params per Epoch (Confident, confirmed in the CSV). Arena Elo 840 is an extrapolated placeholder for a base model (llama-13b, MMLU about 47, sits at 799; palm-2, MMLU 78, at 1004).

DeepMind (counted under gogle). Paper 2022-03-29 (Epoch's date); never released or sold. 70B dense on about 1.4T tokens, trained with roughly the same compute as the 280B Gopher (Epoch 5.76e23 vs 6.31e23) to show the compute-optimal scaling law. MMLU 5-shot 67.6 (Chinchilla paper; the PaLM paper quotes it as 67.5 and the PaLM 2 report as 67.6). Compute and params per Epoch (Confident, confirmed in the CSV). Arena Elo 890 is an extrapolated placeholder for a base model.

Announced 2022-04-04 and never released (announcement date used); the later PaLM API ran PaLM 2. 540B dense, 780B tokens, 6144 TPU v4 chips. MMLU 5-shot 69.3 and HumanEval 0-shot pass@1 26.2 are in the PaLM paper (Table 6 / Table 32, checked). GSM8K 56.5 is 8-shot CoT as listed in the PaLM 2 report (74.4 with self-consistency); the PaLM paper itself shows 54.0 without calculator and 58% with. PaLM-Coder 540B reached HumanEval 35.9 (PaLM 2 report). Compute 2.5272e24 FLOP per Epoch (confirmed, Confident). Base model, so Arena Elo 900 is an estimate.

Free consumer chatbot opened to waitlisted US/UK users 2023-03-21 on a lightweight LaMDA; moved to PaLM 2 on 2023-05-10, Gemini Pro on 2023-12-06, and renamed Gemini on 2024-02-08. No API, price or benchmarks published for the LaMDA version. Arena Elo 960 is an estimate (the later 'Bard (Gemini Pro)' entry sat around 1203 to 1208 in early 2024, but that is a different engine).

Announced at I/O 2023-05-10; offered through the PaLM API and Vertex AI (text-bison and chat-bison sizes). MMLU 5-shot 78.3 (PaLM 2-L, Table 16) and GSM8K 80.7 (8-shot CoT; 91.0 with self-consistency) were checked in the technical report; HumanEval pass@1 37.6 is PaLM 2-S* (code-tuned small, Table 8), so treat as a lower bound. Params 340B and 7.34e24 FLOP are Epoch estimates (confirmed in the CSV; Google did not disclose). Price is UNVERIFIED and approximate: about $0.0005 per 1K characters on Vertex AI converted at 4 chars per token (secondary sources; $0.001/1K chars, i.e. $4 per 1M, is also plausible). Arena: 'palm-2' (chat-bison size) 1004 on 2025-01-21.

Rolled into Bard 2023-12-06; API via AI Studio/Vertex AI from 2023-12-13 (free tier at first). MMLU 5-shot 71.8 (79.1 with CoT@8), GSM8K 11-shot 77.9, HumanEval 0-shot 67.7, GPQA 27.9 (4-shot, so not directly comparable with 0-shot GPQA of other models) all checked in the Gemini 1.5 report's comparison table. Price $0.50/$1.50 per 1M is the Gemini API paid rate from early 2024; the Dec 2023 Vertex price was about $0.00025/$0.0005 per 1K chars. Compute 1.8e25 FLOP is Epoch's speculative benchmark-imputed figure (in the CSV's compute notes) and looks high for a Pro-size model. Arena: gemini-pro-dev-api 1131 on 2025-01-21 (the Bard-style 'gemini-pro' entry is 1110).

Announced 2023-12-06; first public access 2024-02-08 through Gemini Advanced ($19.99/month, Bard renamed Gemini). Vertex AI access was allowlist-only, so api=false and no public per-token price. MMLU 5-shot 83.7 (headline 90.0 used CoT@32), GSM8K 11-shot 88.9 (94.4 maj1@32), HumanEval 74.4, GPQA 35.7 (4-shot) checked in the Gemini 1.5 report. That report also says continued pre-training on one epoch of the HumanEval test split lifted Ultra from 74.4 to 89.0, a warning about leakage in general, not evidence that this model was contaminated. Compute 5e25 FLOP is Epoch's speculative estimate (confirmed). Never on the Arena, so Elo 1190 is my estimate (between gpt-4-0314 at 1186 and Claude 3 Sonnet at 1201).

2024-02-15 was a limited preview (AI Studio/Vertex); API public preview came 2024-04-09 and pay-as-you-go billing started 2024-05-14 (Gemini API changelog). MoE, 1M-token context. Scores are the original Feb 2024 version, all checked in the v1 report: MMLU 5-shot 81.9, GSM8K 11-shot 91.7, HumanEval 71.9, GPQA 41.5 (0-shot). The May 2024 update scored MMLU 85.9, GSM8K 90.8, HumanEval 84.1, GPQA 46.2. Price $3.50/$10.50 per 1M for prompts up to 128K (cut to $1.25/$5 in Sept 2024, a -64% / -52% cut consistent with those figures). Compute 1.58e25 FLOP is Epoch's imputed estimate (CSV compute notes). Arena: gemini-1.5-pro-001, 1260 on 2025-01-21 (closest checkpoint; 002 from Sept 2024 is 1303).

Announced at I/O 2024-05-14 with public preview in AI Studio (GA 2024-05-23). Price $0.35 in / $1.05 out per 1M for prompts up to 128K (Google briefly listed output as $0.53 and called it a typo). MMLU 5-shot 78.9, HumanEval 0-shot 74.3, GSM8K 11-shot 86.2, GPQA 39.5 (0-shot) checked in the latest arXiv version of the Gemini 1.5 report. Arena: gemini-1.5-flash-001, 1227 on 2025-01-21 (002 is 1271). No compute estimate available.

Open-weights (Gemma license) model, 13T training tokens, 8K context, released 2024-06-27 with a 9B sibling. Pretrained 27B, all checked in the Gemma 2 report: MMLU 5-shot 75.2, GSM8K 5-shot 74.0, HumanEval pass@1 51.8; 13T tokens confirmed. Compute is my 6ND estimate (6 x 27.2B x 13T = 2.1e24; Epoch's CSV has no Gemma 2 row). No pricing since Google distributes weights (hosted by third parties). Arena: gemma-2-27b-it, 1220 on 2025-01-21 (the report cited 1218 at launch).

Free experimental model in Google AI Studio and the Gemini API from 2024-12-06 (no paid tier, no pricing; the API changelog has no entry for it), later folded into Gemini 2.0 Pro. It took #1 on LMArena at launch. Google published no benchmark table, so scores are null. Arena: 1374 (2nd in the Jan 2025 leaderboard roundup published 2025-01-22, behind Gemini-2.0-Flash-Thinking at 1380; same scale as the 2025-01-21 dataset). It ranked lower under style control. Not in the HF dataset, which omits experimental models.

Experimental release 2024-12-11 (Gemini API changelog) was free in AI Studio and the Gemini API; $0.10/$0.40 per 1M is the Feb 2025 GA price, used because launch was free, so treat as an approximation. Launch table (checked for consistency against the 1.5 Pro-002 / 1.5 Flash-002 columns quoted in Anthropic's Oct 2024 addendum): MMLU-Pro 76.4, GPQA Diamond 62.1, MATH 89.7, Natural2Code 92.9, LiveCodeBench 35.1, so MMLU, HumanEval and GSM8K are null. The draft's SWE-bench Verified 21.4 came from a later (2025) comparison table for a later checkpoint, not Dec 2024 launch material, so it was removed. Arena: gemini-2.0-flash-exp 1356 in the Jan 2025 leaderboard roundup (published 2025-01-22).

First Google reasoning ('thinking') model, released as a free public preview in AI Studio and the Gemini API on 2024-12-19 (Gemini API changelog); no paid tier at that checkpoint, so api=false and no price. Google published its benchmark charts only in social posts, so scores are left null rather than guessed (the later 01-21 checkpoint was reported with AIME 2024 73.3 and GPQA Diamond 74.2, not verified here). Arena: 1380 belongs to the updated gemini-2.0-flash-thinking-exp-01-21 checkpoint, #1 in the Jan 2025 leaderboard roundup (published 2025-01-22; same scale as the 2025-01-21 dataset: o1-2024-12-17 1351, DeepSeek-V3 1320). The Dec-19 checkpoint itself is not in the HF dataset (it omits experimental models), so this is flagged as an estimate.

caveats:
ARENA SNAPSHOT: All 'not estimated' Elo values come from one source: LMArena's own leaderboard-dataset (Hugging Face, config 'text', split 'full', category 'overall', no style control), leaderboard_publish_date 2025-01-21 (re-read row by row; 158 models). Cross-checks match the Jan-22-2025 news roundup: o1-2024-12-17 1351, DeepSeek-V3 1320, o1-mini 1306, Gemini 1.5 Pro-002 1303. Gemini-Exp-1206 (1374), Gemini 2.0 Flash Exp (1356) and the Flash Thinking line (1380, 01-21 checkpoint) are NOT in that dataset (it omits experimental models), so those come from the Jan 2025 roundup at blogdumoderateur.com (same snapshot era, same scale); Flash Thinking is flagged as an estimate because the value is for the later checkpoint. Claude 1, 2.0, 2.1 and Instant-1 were retired (API 2024-11-06) and are absent from all 2024-25 dataset snapshots: Claude-1 1146 is the 2024-03-26 LMSYS value (Tom's Guide table); the other three use the last published Elo (LMSYS table 2023-12-15: 1130 / 1120 / 1110, Claude-1 then 1151) shifted by -5, the drift seen for Claude-1 and GPT-4-0314 between Dec 2023 and 2024-25, giving 1125 / 1115 / 1105, flagged estimates (about +/-5). BERT 500, T5 650, Meena 760, LaMDA 900, Gopher 840, Chinchilla 890, PaLM 900, Bard 960 and Gemini 1.0 Ultra 1190 are my own extrapolations/placeholders (not chat models or never on the Arena); do not treat as measurements. The openlm.ai figures (a later recalibration, about +20 higher) were NOT used.

SCORE POLICY: standard single-sample settings (MMLU 5-shot, GSM8K greedy/CoT, HumanEval pass@1, GPQA Diamond) rather than more flattering headline numbers (e.g. Gemini 1.0 Ultra MMLU 90.0 CoT@32, GSM8K 94.4 maj1@32); headline values are in notes where relevant. Gemini 1.5 Pro scores are the original Feb 2024 version. GPQA is not uniform across labs: Gemini 1.0 Pro/Ultra are 4-shot, 1.5 Pro/Flash and Claude are 0-shot. BERT's SQuAD (91.8) is a test F1 while T5's (96.2) is a dev F1.

CHANGES FROM THE DRAFT (verification pass): (1) Re-checked against primary PDFs/papers and confirmed: Claude 1.3 / Instant 1.1 / 2 scores (Claude 2 model card), July 2023 prices, Claude 3 / 3.5 scores and SWE-bench numbers (2024 addenda), T5-11B GLUE 90.3 and SQuAD 91.26/96.22 and SuperGLUE 88.9 (previously 'from memory'), BERT GLUE 80.5 and SQuAD 91.8, PaLM MMLU 69.3 and HumanEval 26.2 (previously unverified), PaLM 2 MMLU 78.3 / GSM8K 80.7 / HumanEval 37.6, Gemini 1.0 Pro/Ultra and 1.5 Pro/Flash scores incl. 1.5 Pro GSM8K 91.7 (previously unverified), Gemma 2 27B scores and 13T tokens, Epoch compute/params for Claude 2, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, BERT, T5, Meena, LaMDA, PaLM, PaLM 2, Gemini 1.0 Pro/Ultra, 1.5 Pro (the CSV's numeric compute column is blank for Claude 3 Opus, Gemini 1.0 Pro and 1.5 Pro, but its compute notes give 1.64e25 / 1.8e25 / 1.58e25), release dates from the Anthropic API release notes and the Gemini API changelog. (2) Changed: Claude 3 Sonnet MMLU 78.3 -> 79.0 (launch card; the 78.3 is a later addendum figure); Elo estimates for Claude 2.0 / 2.1 / Instant (1131 / 1118 / 1110 -> 1125 / 1115 / 1105, now traceable to the 2023-12-15 LMSYS table); Gemini 2.0 Flash SWE-bench 21.4 removed (not a Dec 2024 launch figure); removed the unverified 'BERT-Base 78.3' claim; rewrote notes that said 'from memory'; the Claude-1 Elo is now sourced to the Tom's Guide table. (3) Added 3 in-scope items: Gopher (DeepMind, 2021-12-08), Chinchilla (DeepMind, 2022-03-29) and Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental (2024-12-19). Considered but not added: Gemma 1 / Gemma 2 9B and 2B, Gemini 1.5 Flash-8B (2024-10-03), Gemini 1.5 Pro-002, Gemini-Exp-1114/1121, GLaM, Flan-PaLM, Minerva (variants of listed families). (4) Nothing was out of the 2016-06..2024-12-31 window. No model flagged for benchContaminationSuspected (Google's 1.5 report warns about HumanEval leakage in general via a continued-pretraining experiment, not about a released model).

STILL UNVERIFIED (web search budget ran out mid-pass): PaLM 2 price ($2 vs $4 per 1M, Vertex per-character conversion), Claude 3 Haiku GSM8K 88.9 (launch card not retrievable, over 10MB), exact Elo of Claude 2.0 / 2.1 / Instant (estimates), the Dec-2024 Gemini 2.0 Flash launch table (kept: values consistent with the adjacent 1.5-002 columns quoted in Anthropic's addendum), Gemini 1.5 Pro price on the exact day of 2024-05-14 (the Sept 2024 cut percentages back out $3.50/$10.50). Prices are USD per 1M tokens at or near launch; PaLM 2 and Gemini 1.0 Pro are conversions from per-character Vertex AI pricing and Gemini 2.0 Flash uses the Feb 2025 GA price because the Dec 2024 launch was free. Compute/params come from Epoch AI's notable_ai_models.csv; entries marked speculative or imputed there (Claude 2/3 Opus/3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.0 Pro/Ultra/1.5 Pro) are low confidence, and Gemma 2 compute is my own 6ND estimate. Anthropic params are undisclosed (null). Totals: 10 Anthropic and 17 Google/DeepMind models; 'Claude Instant' is a single entry covering 1.x versions.
